articles.title: A Wild Thanksgiving: Storms, Blackouts and a Delayed Parade
articles.summary: A huge Thanksgiving storm knocked out power for nearly a million people, delayed travel and flooded coastal areas — and pushed the 100th Macy's parade to Saturday.

articles.title: Asylum at the Southern Border Heads to the Supreme Court
articles.summary: The Supreme Court will soon decide whether the president can suspend asylum at the southern border on his own — a case both sides say could reshape the system.

articles.title: Can We Trust AI Too Much? A Robotics Pioneer Has Questions
articles.summary: Robotics pioneer Dr. Ayanna Howard warns that we often trust AI too much — and says students need to learn to use it wisely.
